items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: To my estimation, Raymond's one of the best.

ctx.x: Doesn't play much up high usually like you do. Oh, he plays very high up high. You cover the high instrument. Yeah, he can too. Yeah, he can too. Yeah.
To my estimation, Raymond's one of the best.

Well, I was wondering, to get back to that low register business, one of those English records, the original Dixieland made over there, had a solo by your brother all in the low register, which he didn't usually do in the other records. Yeah, I had that record. Did he ever play that way much around here? That is, did he keep going up and down covering the whole instrument or did he sometimes just stick to one register for a solo?
